sourceQuote: The School of Aeronautics, School of Materials Science and Engineering, School of Mechanical Engineering, School of Electronics and Information, School of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering, School of Life Science and School of Foreign Studies require that the Master Program Applicants have to have the acceptance letter from supervisors to complete the application.
targetQuote: 航空学院、材料科学与工程学院、机械工程学院、电子信息学院、化学与化工学院、生命科学学院和外国语学院要求硕士项目申请人必须取得导师接收函才能完成申请。
